summary: A Quote subscription: a market-feed packet with no trade time (0) gives a Quote frame without ltt.

notes: A trade time of 0 is no trade yet: the frame has no `ltt` (lead decision 2026-11-09, review round: never the receipt time); the web sends `ltt: 0`.

deviations.reason: The web sends zero; the docs say leave it out (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, "Field availability": a field the stream does not carry is not invented as zero; lead decision 2026-11-09). A trade time of 0 is no trade yet; the web passes the 0 on as ltt, the desktop leaves ltt out and never puts the receipt time in its place (lead decision 2026-11-09, review round).

The web multiplies the packet's integer price by 1/divisor, which is inexact in binary (148510 x 0.01 = 1485.1000000000001); the desktop divides by the divisor and sends the price the exchange quoted.
